Reasoning methods

Zero-shot step-by-step prompting

A simple step-by-step instruction improved reasoning results without worked examples in the prompt.

Takeshi Kojima and colleagues

The contribution

The paper investigated prompting language models to reason through a problem before extracting an answer. The phrase “Let's think step by step” improved performance on several benchmark tasks without supplying task-specific reasoning demonstrations.

What this does not establish

The effect is empirical and task-dependent. It neither guarantees valid reasoning nor makes every model a reliable zero-shot reasoner.

Why this date?

The preprint was submitted on 24 May 2022. This is the source for the familiar zero-shot phrase, distinct from Wei and colleagues' worked-example method.
